item.tib: bstan srung a bse rgyal ba'i gsol mchod kyi phrin las
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni bstan srung a bse rgyal ba sgrub thabs dang las mtha' phun sum tshogs pa mnga' bas/ 'di 'dra dpyad pa cig dgos thang ste/ phugs 'di 'dra'i dpe cha ma 'dzoms pas bskang (skong) mdos sogs 'bul ba/ yid ches kyi las tshogs ma mchis tshe/ dmu rigs rong rang dam pa shes rab dbang ldan gyis nan tan du bskul ngor/ ?nam gyi (gyis shing bya'i lo dbyar ra ba'i yar tshes la/ yi dam gyer phur gyi sgrubs (bsgrub) pa'i skabs su/ sngon dus bskang (skong) ba rnams la gzhi blangs nas rtsom par bgyid pa la/ ma rig dbang gi 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ lha dang srung ma'i thugs la bzod par gsol/ dge legs yon tan sgrub rgyud zab mo yi/ bstan pa nyi zla bzhin du gsal bar gsol//
